description: This Java class 'MDCWrapper' acts as a wrapper around the SLF4J MDC component, providing methods to put and remove diagnostic context information for logging purposes.

classes.name: MDCWrapper
classes.description: A Spring component that wraps SLF4J's MDC to add or remove context information for logging.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the MDC for logging context.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key from the MDC to clear context information.
